name: Balboa Peninsula
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Balboa Peninsula?
answer_short: Yes, with limits. In Balboa Peninsula, golf carts may use streets posted 25 mph or less and LSVs streets posted 35 mph or less. Both stay off Pacific Coast Highway.

rules.rule: Golf carts on highways posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district
LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less
Golf carts aren't allowed on Pacific Coast Highway

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Balboa Island?
faq.a: Yes. Balboa Island streets are posted 25 mph or less, so golf carts may use them.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on PCH in Newport Beach?
faq.a: No. Pacific Coast Highway is posted well above 25 mph and police say carts aren't allowed on it.
